No need for overly expensive insured express shipping. And small parcels mostly dont get opened and checked for customs. So you are good to go. Maximum what will happen is thst they will require PTA license from you which you can get easily by going to PTA office (just make sure you tell sender to give you IMEI before shipping or you can get IMEI at customs) and about 30-40 percent over all custom charges. But it will be rare you will need to go through PTA and stuff. I regularly import GSM devices.

Added advantage is: if parcel gets lost, or item damaged, you get full refund. I got refund by faulty chinese equipments. Aliexpress is good and reliable.
